title: A missing checkpoint silently baselines past retained log-clear evidence
recommendation: Persist a separately authenticated installation epoch outside the replaceable cursor; reject link/reparse and unstable file identities, enforce monotonic anti-rollback, treat a post-install missing checkpoint as untrusted, replay a bounded retained window including explicit clear/tamper event IDs on genuine first enrollment, and promote only after stable anchors.

title: The continuity guard can bridge old rows to a post-clear terminal anchor
recommendation: Stage records, revalidate both the original admission anchor and terminal anchor immediately before an expected-prior checkpoint commit, discard the batch and report/replay on any generation change, and publish only after the transition succeeds.

title: Effective SSH configuration and key custody are not baselined across configured sources
recommendation: Resolve and aggregate-hash a strictly bounded, canonical, reparse-safe include graph; inventory configured key/CA/principals sources; flag command-backed sources explicitly; and add native Windows ACL custody verification to the authenticated baseline.

title: Default Windows OpenSSH authentication and non-service tunnel activity are blind
recommendation: Add a fixed-provider, bounded OpenSSH Windows event-channel adapter and enumerate sshd.exe/ssh.exe process and socket evidence bound to PID birth and executable identity, retaining only normalized forwarding flags and keyed endpoints with explicit source-completeness state.

title: Network drift state and collection quality reset across process restarts
recommendation: Use a purpose-derived stable key and strict HMAC-authenticated persisted baseline with provisional/trusted states; expose per-interface/family completeness, withhold healthy baseline promotion when incomplete, enforce child-output limits during pipe reads, and collect DNS/DHCP/routes/neighbors with structured interface binding.

title: Gateway attestation labels an interface despite competing or unobserved egress routes
recommendation: Bind attestation to the selected default egress route for each family, including interface index, gateway, metric and interface epoch before and after exchange; represent trust per route/family, collect Windows IPv4 and IPv6 routes, and keep the interface untrusted on incomplete or competing bypass paths.

title: Live defense messages can expose MAC/SSID/user text and path fragments
recommendation: Define and enforce an identity-free EventBus public-message contract, add MAC/SSID and robust spaced/quoted-path redaction, and test the live card with actual messages from identifier-bearing producers.

title: The network monitor's advertised non-Windows support is skipped by preflight
recommendation: Add a literal module-level SUPPORTED_PLATFORMS tuple and non-Windows discovery regressions while preserving the conservative Windows-only default for undeclared legacy modules.

title: Defense Memory reads an unbounded, reparse-following asset before enforcing its cap
recommendation: Require a regular resource-root-contained non-reparse file, open it once with no-follow/stable-identity checks, read at most MAX_FILE_BYTES plus one, and retain the existing canonical digest, strict schema, structure and governance validation after the bounded read.
